reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend that all three date paths (shared getNextDate, schedules/app getOccurrenceDay, budget schedule-template) already call, and replaces the local MAX_WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS/WEEKDAY_LOOKAHEAD use with shared helpers.

duplication.why: The non-working-day test exists once (isNonWorkingDay) and the window-size math once (getMaxNonWorkingRun/getWeekdayLookahead); call sites only pass their holidays field.

placement.why: Date-moving logic and lookahead bounds live in shared/schedules.ts, the module that already owns weekend solving; server callers just forward config.

scope.why: Type field, the shared function, its three callers, parseRecurDate passthrough and tests only.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition; the 2 + 3*n bound is a slightly opaque heuristic, but it is named and commented in one place.

one_place.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend/isNonWorkingDay in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getOccurrenceDay and budget/schedule-template.ts resolveSkippedWeekend
